component.name: Inkwell
component.summary: Run Inkling 2 Mini on your own PC

description.p: Inkwell builds llama.cpp for your graphics card (CUDA, Vulkan, ROCm or CPU), downloads the Inkling 2 Mini model size that fits your PC, and gives you a native chat app with image input. It can share the model with your phone as an OpenAI-compatible API and connect it to the dsh coding agent.
